SELECT evaluation_run_id FROM task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{taskId}

SELECT id,evaluation_run_id FROM task t WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND record_version IN (1,2,3) AND (state='QUEUED' OR (state='RESUME_READY' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM task_attempt a LEFT JOIN worker_process w ON w.id=a.worker_id WHERE a.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND a.task_id=t.id AND a.quiescent=FALSE AND (w.id IS NULL OR w.stopped=FALSE)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM reservation r WHERE r.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND r.id=CONCAT(t.id,':run') AND r.state='RESERVED')) OR (state='RUNNING' AND lease_until<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (FIND_IN_SET('working_directory',t.capabilities)=0 OR (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM task_attempt a LEFT JOIN worker_process w ON w.id=a.worker_id WHERE a.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND a.task_id=t.id AND a.quiescent=FALSE AND (w.id IS NULL OR w.stopped=FALSE)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM native_search_run n WHERE n.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND n.task_id=t.id AND n.phase<>'STOPPED'))))) ORDER BY ready_at,id LIMIT 1
